examples.chinese: 我上個禮拜認識了一位中文老師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge lǐbài rènshi le yí wèi Zhōngwén lǎoshī.
examples.english: Last week I got to know a Chinese teacher.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，我認識了很多國家的新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ rènshi le hěn duō guójiā de xīn péngyǒu.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have met many new friends from many countries.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡去旅行，因為可以認識很多有趣的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān qù lǚxíng, yīnwèi kěyǐ rènshi hěn duō yǒuqù de rén.
examples.english: I like to travel because I can meet many interesting people.

examples.chinese: 我覺得你一個人跟不認識的人見面，不太安全。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ yīgè rén gēn bù rènshi de rén jiànmiàn, bù tài ānquán.
examples.english: I think it's not very safe for you to meet someone you don't know by yourself.

examples.chinese: 她很害羞，不敢跟不認識的人說話。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn hàixiū, bù gǎn gēn bù rènshi de rén shuōhuà.
examples.english: She is very shy and doesn't dare talk to people she doesn't know.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。
我看到前面有人跟我揮手，可是我不認識那個人。
在自由戀愛的時代中，還是有人透過相親的方式來認識另一半。

items.wordHook: 認(know) + 識(know) → knowing, doubled: 認識(to get to know someone).

examples.chinese: 知道，友美跟我講過。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào, Yǒuměi gēn wǒ jiǎng guò.
examples.english: Yes, Youmei told me already.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: 李先生喜歡開玩笑，是一個很有趣的人。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānsheng xǐhuan kāi wánxiào, shì yīgè hěn yǒuqù de rén.
examples.english: Mr. Li likes to make jokes; he is a very interesting person.

examples.chinese: 他只是開個小玩笑而已，你何必那麼在乎呢？
這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
examples.english: The rent for this house does not include the water fee and electricity fee.

學習不應該只在校園裡，也包括課外學習。
最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

items.wordHook: You open (開) the curtain, and the show begins (始): 開始 is 'to start'.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生對客人很親切，讓客人都吃得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng duì kèrén hěn qīnqiè, ràng kèrén dōu chī de hěn kāixīn.

當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。

企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。

items.wordHook: Using a sharp 金(gold) chisel to 彔(carve wood) historical archives preserves an enduring 錄(record).

examples.chinese: 李太太擔心孩子因為吃得太少，長不高，你有什麼好主意？
李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。

items.wordHook: The guiding thought a 主(master) forms with inner 意(idea) is a clever 主意(idea).

examples.chinese: 一般人都喜歡跟性格溫柔、樂觀的人交朋友。

items.wordHook: Combining 性(sex) and 格(form): 性格 means character, personality.

items.wordHook: Combining 碰(touch) and 到(go to): 碰到 means encounter, to bump into.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。

items.wordHook: When qualities 適(match) perfectly and 合(combine): 適合 means fit, suitable.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。

items.wordHook: Combining 生(birth) and 產(give birth): 生產 means produce.

items.wordHook: Combining 平(flat) and 原(source): 平原 means plain.

items.wordHook: You 走(walk) through the 旱(dry) desert, pressing on to 趕(pursue).

items.wordHook: There is 不(no) need to 用(use) words to 說(speak): 不用說 means needless to say.
Combining 原(source) and 因(cause): 原因 means reason.
Under 一(one) sun, a 自(self) takes a 夊(slow step) → the slow days of 夏(summer).
An 八(eight) of tiny dots huddles around one center point → 小(small).
年輕 means young: your years (年) are still light (輕), not weighed down by age.
A 弋(catch) of a 工(work) pattern gives a set formula: 式(formula).
a 音(sound) lands on a 心(heart) and stirs one 意(thought).
Combining 成(become) and 就(approach): 成就 means accomplishment.
Willing to 放(release) tension so body and mind become 輕(light) and calm 鬆(pine tree): 放輕鬆 means relax.
a 吂(speechless) runner by the 月(moon) takes 貝(sea shell) coin as 卂(fly rapidly) flags hail the 贏(win).
a 口(mouth) shouts 止(stop) at a 沓(pad) of feet → 踏(trample).
With swift 辶(movement), an arrow flies straight through the target with elegant 秀(elegant) precision to 透(pierce).
Combining 預(prepare) and 報(announce): 預報 means forecast.
